steps.what: Confirm the assigned route, direction and stop sequence
Announce routine stops as the bus approaches them
Correct announcements and explain changed stops or diversions to passengers

tasks.design: Configure native stop announcements in the {OTHER} onboard passenger-information system using the confirmed service and existing vehicle positioning. Keep route confirmation, monitoring and corrections with the driver; stale position or unmatched routes suppress automatic announcements and require manual information.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine stop names are spoken repeatedly even when the service and position are already known.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic stop matching and approved announcement content can cover routine services where suitable onboard equipment exists.
tasks.still_hard: Diversions, position errors and making corrections understandable to passengers.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing a misleading announcement and explaining actual travel options.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated speaking on supported routes; driver responsibility for corrections remains.

reach.task: Resolve a mismatch between assigned service and stop announcements
reach.learn: Service identifiers, direction and diversion update procedures

evidence.claim: Position-triggered native stop announcements are an E1 proposal; the digest has no bus announcement product or measured case.

assumptions: Boundary is driver stop-announcement work, excluding driving, timetable planning and passenger assistance. Savings apply only where routine announcements are currently manual.

The dispatcher produces service identifier, route revision, direction and ordered stop identifiers through existing scheduling. In fully retained s1 the driver selects and verifies that context; no free driver capture is assumed.
An existing onboard positioning unit produces timestamped position and validity status. No new sensor installation is assumed; absent or stale data requires manual announcements.

The passenger-information planner produces and verifies stop names, announcement content and trigger mappings. Extra capture and content maintenance are counted as four other-role hours per 100 driver baseline hours, with initial setup included in build days.
Test native onboard configuration first. No model chooses stops; no driver performance ranking is introduced. New monitoring consultation and access depend on national rules.
The 15 retained exception hours include attention to incorrect output. Unsupported routes use manual announcements; existing automatic announcements earn no new saving.
research_questions: Can native stop matching reliably suppress stale or incorrect announcements on diversions?

already_counted.description: Monitor and correct misleading or missing announcements

incremental.description: Driver checks of announcement faults and service mismatches outside routine duty
Planner capture and verification of content, trigger mappings and changed stop data

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=15+70*0+15=30; gross=70, driver upkeep=3, net=67. High assumes currently manual routine announcements on equipped services; low assumes announcements already run automatically and added checks yield no gross saving. Four other-role upkeep hours remain separate and must be included in team economics.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist passengers and answer route questions

steps.what: Assist passengers boarding, alighting, seating and carrying baggage according to their needs
Answer passenger questions about bus schedules and routes with relevant context

tasks.design: Retain physical assistance and direct responses to passenger questions. Existing service information in {OPS_SYSTEM} can support the driver, but a passenger-facing screen does not remove assistance or guarantee an understood answer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs vary by passenger and depend on safe boarding, mobility and actual travel context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing information tools support answers without replacing personal assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a passenger's needs and responding safely with limited time.
tasks.human_edge: Patient explanation, physical support and checking understanding.
tasks.altitude: No change to assistance time or responsibility.

reach.learn: Safe assistance techniques and accessibility needs

evidence.claim: Retaining passenger assistance and contextual answers is an E1 judgement, with no measured saving claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes driver assistance and direct questions, excluding route planning and generic announcements.
Passengers communicate their needs in the fully retained interaction; no structured disability profile or destination capture is assumed.
The dispatcher supplies current service information through existing work. Clarification remains manual; zero upkeep because no change is introduced.
unknowns: Passenger accessibility needs and available assistance facilities
research_questions: Where do passengers need personal explanation even when information is displayed?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=80+20=100; gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical assistance and direct questions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect tickets or cash fares, check entitlement and handle payment exceptions

tasks.design: Retain the driver's actual ticket and cash handling at the {OTHER} ticketing terminal. Electronic validation may already operate alongside this work; its existing runtime earns no saving, and a new cashless-service policy is outside this proposal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Remaining cash, ticket and exception interactions depend on passenger circumstances and fare policy.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing ticketing equipment handles routine transactions without eliminating the manual interactions that remain.
tasks.still_hard: Invalid tickets, concession questions and passengers unable to use electronic payment.
tasks.human_edge: Fair handling of payment exceptions and clear explanations.
tasks.altitude: No change to fare authority or manual collection time.

reach.task: Resolve a fare entitlement query under approved policy

evidence.claim: Retaining existing manual fare interactions is an E1 design judgement; the digest supplies no bus fare-collection automation case.

assumptions: Boundary is driver labour in collecting tickets or cash and handling exceptions; passenger effort and automatic validation runtime are excluded.
The passenger presents the ticket or payment; the driver checks it during fully retained s1. No free structured concession or payment-status input is assumed.
Existing authorised fare administration supplies the rules. Missing entitlement information requires normal manual clarification.
Zero upkeep because no new policy, terminal or software configuration is introduced.
research_questions: What manual collection work remains after existing electronic validation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No passenger effort transfer or existing validator runtime is credited.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Report delays or accidents promptly and clarify immediate circumstances with dispatch
Record verified delay or accident details in the required report

tasks.design: Keep urgent verbal reporting and clarification with the driver. Configure an incident form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse verified service details while the driver captures the event facts and approves the exact saved report when safely stationary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Follow-up records repeat assignment details around manually described event facts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can prefill existing assignment metadata without inferring an accident or its cause.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate observations, urgent escalation and separating facts from uncertain explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining the situation and recognising immediate safety needs.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated report metadata; emergency communication and factual responsibility stay human.

reach.task: Reconcile an incident record with the current service assignment

evidence.claim: Native incident forms and the driver-specific saving are E1 proposals; the digest explicitly lacks a measured bus-reporting case.

assumptions: Boundary is the driver's immediate report and subsequent record, excluding emergency response, investigations and dispatcher labour.

The dispatcher supplies service, vehicle and assignment identifiers in existing scheduling. In s2 the driver verifies these and captures event time, location, observed facts, immediate actions and uncertainty; all first capture and checking remain within its 18 retained hours.
Missing assignment fields or event facts require manual entry. No transcript, automatic accident flag, location feed or inferred fault code is assumed.

Test native forms before custom code. Urgent reporting never waits for form completion; data entry occurs only when safely stationary. National access and staff consultation rules need local confirmation.
unknowns: Current incident form and duplicate metadata burden
Assignment data access and local report requirements
research_questions: How much repeated entry can a native form remove after all event capture and verification?

already_counted.description: First event capture, metadata checks and final record approval

incremental.description: Maintain form fields, assignment mapping and missing-data checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact incident record, assignment, event time and location, factual narrative and stated uncertainties; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=70+30*0.60=88; gross=12, upkeep=2, net=10. High assumes repeated assignment entry; low assumes existing single-entry reporting leaves no gross saving while upkeep remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Routine announcements and repeated report metadata may shrink on equipped services; driving, assistance and immediate incident communication remain human.
reach: Coordinate accessible boarding with passenger attendants
role.ambitious_version: Use reduced routine speaking and recording burden to protect attention for passengers and service conditions.
